notes: This file is the single source of truth for every label/tag used across ClickUp and GitHub. Adding, renaming, or removing a label is a PR to this file, never an ad-hoc tag typed into the ClickUp or GitHub UI. Anything applied to a task or PR that is not defined here is sprawl and gets flagged by migrate_clickup_labels.py --audit.

rules.form: namespace:value, lowercase, ascii, hyphen-separated values only
rules.max_labels_per_task_guidance: one lane, one model, one risk, zero-or-more flow, zero-or-more area, one src

lane.purpose: Which execution lane owns the work.

code.desc: Software engineering work: repos, scripts, infrastructure-as-code.

content.desc: Written content work: copy, blog posts, marketing collateral.

design.desc: Visual/UX design work: mockups, brand assets, layouts.

ops.desc: Operational work: deploys, monitors, credentials, fleet upkeep.

model.purpose: Minimum model tier required to execute the task; a floor, never a ceiling.

haiku.desc: Mechanical, low-judgment work safe for the cheapest tier.

sonnet.desc: Default working tier for most agent-executable tasks.

opus.desc: Requires stronger reasoning: ambiguous scope, multi-step judgment.

fable.desc: Requires orchestration-grade judgment across a large or costly task.

human.desc: Not agent-executable at any model tier; requires a person.

risk.purpose: Blast radius of the change; drives which autonomous-merge tier gate applies.

low.desc: Small, reversible blast radius; gated by HERMES_AUTONOMOUS_MERGE_LOW.

medium.desc: Moderate blast radius or partial reversibility; gated by HERMES_AUTONOMOUS_MERGE_MEDIUM.

high.desc: Large or hard-to-reverse blast radius; gated by HERMES_AUTONOMOUS_MERGE_HIGH.

flow.purpose: Cross-cutting lifecycle signals that board status alone does not express.

needs-prep.desc: Not yet groomed; blocking questions or scope gaps remain.

prepped.desc: Groomed and ready for an executor to claim.

prep-blocked.desc: Grooming stalled on a dependency outside the task itself.

needs-human.desc: Requires a person's judgment or approval before it can proceed.

needs-validation.desc: Work is done and awaiting the validator's QA pass.

validate-failed.desc: The validator rejected the work; sent back for rework.

blocked.desc: Stalled on an external dependency, credential, or decision.

superseded.desc: Replaced by newer work; kept for history, not actionable.

duplicate.desc: Duplicates another tracked task; not independently actionable.

src.purpose: Provenance of the task: who or what filed it.

hermes.desc: Filed autonomously by the Hermes agent.

audit.desc: Filed by an audit or monitor run.

area.purpose: Subject matter of the work. The only namespace allowed to grow, and only via a PR to this file.

infra.desc: Core infrastructure: deploy pipelines, servers, fleet config.

content.desc: Editorial or marketing content subject matter.

pr-pipeline.desc: Pull-request creation, review, and merge automation.
